# WO-109: Published download metadata consistency regression tests (CP-12)
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (channel)
Assigned to: Codex channel session (Nora dispatches)
Source: docs/vendor/CODEX_PROPOSALS.md CP-12 (accepted 2026-11-08)

## Goal
Per CP-12: the built /download/ page's version, size, fingerprint/checksum fragment and primary download link agree with the checked-in release data (site_src/data/release.yaml and the web release data). A tag alone is never a release. Test-only.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Built-site tests use the `test_web_` prefix (CI runs them in pages.yml), offline, no network, no new dependencies.
- `pnpm build`, `pnpm check`, content_check and ruff pass; existing tests stay green.
- Report product defects found; don't fix product files outside the allowed paths.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- tests/test_web_download_metadata.py
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
CSP, build config, dependencies, release.yaml/site data, workflows, FaqList/FAQ copy, the home markup.

## Check-in plan
Report in docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md when done.
